dedupe_keys.name: planet labs satellite imagery planetscope superdove skysat pelican tanager monitoring mosaics and planetary variables

description: Planet operates several Earth observation satellite constellations and sells imagery, tasking, analysis-ready products and derived variables through the Planet Insights Platform. Coverage: global; the SuperDove constellation gives near-daily global coverage in eight spectral bands; SkySat gives 50 cm imagery with sub-daily revisit; Pelican is the newer rapid-response high-resolution constellation, Owl the next-generation monitoring constellation, and Tanager a hyperspectral satellite aimed at methane emissions monitoring among other uses; products include Planet Monitoring, Planet Tasking, SuperRes, Analytic Feeds, Hyperspectral, Planetary Variables, Mosaics and forest carbon; industry pages cover energy and infrastructure asset monitoring, maritime vessel detection, emergency management, water management, insurance, mapping and science programmes. Format and access: the Planet Insights Platform and Explorer with APIs and developer documentation, subscriptions and tasking by sales contact; publications and science programmes for research users. Licence: commercial licence terms, not read. Caveats: the pricing page renders no figures without scripts, so costs and licence tiers were not read; spectral bands, archive start dates and delivery formats of each product were not checked. Simulation uses: frequent imagery for monitoring infrastructure construction and condition, mapping flood and wildfire extents for hazard exposure and emergency response, and methane leak detection for gas networks. Related records: Vantor WorldView imagery (data-vantor-maxar-worldview-satellite-imagery-vivid-basemaps) and Nearmap aerial imagery (data-nearmap-aerial-imagery-and-ai-layers).
